operation_envelope.seat: authenticated by authoritative server, never from packet
operation_envelope.unitId: one of five team-controlled champion IDs
operation_envelope.sequence: per-seat positive safe integer; identical already-acknowledged retry returns same receipt without side effect
operation_envelope.canonical: include selected unitId, kind, exact payload and seat scope in replay key; conflicting payload with same sequence rejected
operation_envelope.payload: all keys allowlisted; no client-supplied team, gold, inventory or snapshots
operation_envelope.phase: item operations only during planning/preparation with unready team; reaction exception separate

invariants.gold: integer bounded and server owned; no duplicate sale/refund/credit; per-item official gold.sell
invariants.recipes: every component instance consumed no more than once; completed item cost net of owned components
invariants.inventory: six regular item slots; trinkets excluded; max five health potions; normal starter/unique restrictions
invariants.fountain: authoritative physical map distance; no browser-provided shop flag; respawn/dead exception documented
invariants.undo: history bound 16, departed shop visit irrevocably invalidated, returning does not restore; after new purchase new history allowed
invariants.jungle_support: jungle pet required and role-locked, support quest item protected against sale
invariants.privacy: no enemy inventory, gold, Undo receipts or RNG in own seat public projection

replay_order.finding: per-team economy commutes, full snapshot digest does not, due to ordered global event history
replay_order.required_action: persist globally ordered authoritative command receipts before replay; do not independently sort per-seat packets

write_scope: Specialist branch only, no direct writes to coordinator, PR19 or legacy integration
